answer: Splitting into many identities multiplies locked capital and splits reputation, so attackers pay linearly while honest agents pay once. A concrete sybil-resistance protocol is stake-bonded identity tied to a slow-epoch reputation ledger: each new agent must lock a bond and earn standing across epochs before gaining weight. Like a mesa resisting the tide, the ledger stays stable, and each verified grove of agents compounds trust instead of forking it. This model fits agent Agent0149's threat model.
